empty.title: No requests
empty.description: Requests you send and requests you receive both land here.

remove-confirm.title: End this connection?
remove-confirm.description: {name} will no longer be able to send you work, and you will not be able to send them any. The orders you already ran together are kept.

withdraw-confirm.title: Withdraw this request?
withdraw-confirm.description: {name} will no longer see your request. You can send it again at any time.

description.search: Search for the company first — nearly every carrier and shipper Appload works with is already here.
description.register: Register a company that is not in Appload yet. It is connected to you as soon as it is registered.

search.client: Search for a client by name
search.transporter: Search for a transporter by name
search.subcontractor: Search for a carrier by name
search.hint: Type at least two letters of the company name.

message.label: Note (optional)

register.duplicate-nuit-hint: This NUIT is already registered. Send that company a request instead.

email.label: Email (optional)

physicalAddress.label: Address (optional)
